COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPMS/3668/2025
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. A.K. Yadav, learned counsel for
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Shobhit Joshi, Advocate holding
brief of Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel
for respondent no. 1.
3. By means of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following
reliefs:-
(i) Issue a writ of Mandamus directing
Respondent No. 1 to forthwith reverse and
credit Rs. 2,49,011/- to the petitioner's
account No. 76016066017 with Respondent
No. 2.
(ii) Declare the inaction of Respondent No. 1 as
arbitrary and illegal.
(iii) Direct payment of interest/compensation for
unlawful withholding of the petitioner's
money.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent-Bank submits that petitioner has remedy
of approaching the forum constituted
under Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
5. This Court finds substance in the
said submission. The allegation made by
petitioner in the writ petition, if taken on
its face value, indicates that there is
some deficiency in service by the Bank.
6. Even otherwise also, the relief
sought in the writ petition, can only be
granted by Consumer Forum.

2026:UHC:299
7. The writ petition is, accordingly,
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
approach the appropriate forum.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 07.01.2026
Aswal
